layout.title: Workspace settings
layout.subtitle: How Sinji reads the tone of your calls, transcribes audio and which AI keys it uses.

rubric.title: Scoring rubric
rubric.subtitle: The criteria every call is scored against, and how much each one counts. Every score is shown with the quote that earned it.

shared.title: Using the shared default rubric
shared.body: This workspace has no rubric of its own yet, so calls are scored with the shared default (version {{version}}). Saving creates your own copy and detaches it from the default.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Each dimension is scored 0 to 100. The weights decide how the final score is built and must add up to 100%.
dimensions.none: No dimensions yet. Add at least one.

field.name: Name
field.guidanceHint: What earns a high score and what caps it.

measured.note: Sinji measures this from the call itself, so only its weight can be changed.

text.title: Free-text rubric
text.description: House rules that apply to every dimension.
text.label: Instructions for the scorer
text.hint: Optional. Tell the scorer what to ignore, which sources to trust and how to treat missing evidence.
text.placeholder: Score the agent, not the customer. Quote the line that justifies every score.

errors.title: Fix these before saving
errors.sum: The weights must add up to 100% (now {{sum}}%).
errors.duplicate_key: Two dimensions share the same identifier.

validate.ok: The rubric is valid and ready to save.

draft.title: Unsaved draft
draft.body: The measured dimensions were kept. Review the criteria and weights, then save when you are happy with them.

import.title: Draft a rubric from a document
import.description: Upload your QA scorecard, onboarding guide or call script. Sinji reads it and proposes dimensions you can edit.
import.hint: Have a QA form already? Import it and edit the draft instead of starting from blank.
import.choose: Choose a document or drop it here
import.formats: PDF, Word, text or Markdown, up to 10 MB
import.wait: This takes a few seconds. You can cancel at any time.
import.loaded: Draft loaded. Review it, then save.
import.tooBig: That file is larger than 10 MB.
import.failed: The import failed. Try another file.

reset.title: Reset to the shared default?
reset.body: Your own rubric will be removed and calls will be scored with the shared default again. Confirm with your password.
reset.wrong: Wrong password (403). The rubric was not reset.
reset.done: Rubric reset to the shared default

bands.title: Score colour bands
bands.description: Where a score turns amber and green on scorecards, call lists and charts.
bands.greenHint: Scores from here up are green.
bands.previewLabel: Red below {{amber}}, amber from {{amber}}, green from {{green}}
bands.failed: Could not save the score bands.

errors.amber: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99.
errors.green: Enter a whole number from 2 to 100.

sentiment.title: Sentiment analysis
sentiment.description: Reads the tone of the words and, separately, the tone of the voice. The two are never averaged, so a polite customer with an angry voice is flagged as a conflict.
sentiment.enableHint: When off, calls are not tone-checked and the tone lane stays empty.
sentiment.guidanceHint: Context about your callers that changes how tone should be read. {{n}} / {{max}}
sentiment.placeholder: For example: callers about overdue payments are often upset; judge the agent's calm, not the customer's mood.
sentiment.failed: Could not save the sentiment settings.

service.title: Voice-tone service
service.description: The model that listens to how the voice sounds.

ok.label: Running
ok.hint: The voice-tone service is answering normally.

warming.label: Warming up
warming.hint: The model is loading. Voice tone will be available in a few seconds.

model_error.label: Model error
model_error.hint: The model returned an error. Calls are analysed on words only until it recovers.

unreachable.label: Unreachable
unreachable.hint: Sinji cannot reach the service. Calls are analysed on words only.

disabled.label: Off
disabled.hint: Sentiment analysis is switched off for this workspace.

transcription.title: Transcription
transcription.description: Defaults for every new recording. A single file can still override them when you upload it.
transcription.languageHint: Auto-detect works well unless your calls mix languages.
transcription.formatHint: How the recording is prepared before transcription.
transcription.diarizeHint: Labels who is speaking so lines can be attributed to the agent or the customer.
transcription.keytermsHint: One per line: product names, jargon and places the transcriber should spell correctly. Up to {{max}} terms, each under {{chars}} characters and at most {{words}} words.

errors.too_many_words: Line {{line}}: "{{term}}" has too many words (at most {{words}}).
errors.tooMany: That is too many terms (at most {{max}}).

transcription.failed: Could not save the transcription settings.
transcription.revertBody: Your workspace override is removed and new recordings use the platform defaults again.

effective.title: In effect
effective.description: What new recordings use, and where each value comes from.

transcription.chain: Order of precedence: built-in default, platform default, your workspace, then the single file.

ai.intro: Sinji uses the platform's AI by default. Add your own provider key per capability to run that capability on your own account. Precedence: platform default, then the connection assigned to you, then your own key.

tts.name: Text to speech
tts.description: Voices for the text-to-speech tool and the bot.

ai.needsKey: Your override is on but has no key, so the connection above still applies.
ai.overrideOff: Your override is switched off. {{name}} applies.
ai.byoNote: Removing your key falls back to {{name}}.

override.title: Your own key
override.readOnlySet: An owner has set an own-key override for this capability.
override.readOnlyNone: No own-key override is set. An owner can add one.

key.label: API key
key.hint: Write-only. The key is stored masked and is never shown again.
key.stored: A key ending {{hint}} is stored. Type a new one to replace it.

ai.notesHint: Why this override exists, for your team. {{n}} / {{max}}
ai.enableHint: Requests for this capability are sent with your key and counted as your own usage.

defaultRubric.title: Default rubric
defaultRubric.description: The rubric used by every workspace that has not saved one of its own.
defaultRubric.note: Changing this affects only workspaces on the shared default. Workspaces with their own rubric keep it.
